description: Direção-Geral do Território: positioning datasets is a collection of datasets listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Direção-Geral do Território. Coverage: Direção-Geral do Território. The listing groups 4 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about positioning; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Rede Geodésica Nacional - RGN; SRUP - Marcos Geodésicos; Rede de Nivelamento Geométrico de Alta Precisão - RNGAP; Rede Nacional de Estações Permanentes GNSS – ReNEP. Formats seen: WMS, WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
